name: Scout agent orchestration stack
description: Profile for evaluating repos against Scout/Hermes-style agent orchestration, evidence, and no-exec safety constraints.

export_policy.notes: Raw scan evidence, repo snapshots, scanner output, and probe artifacts remain in the repo-scout corpus/workspace. Downstream consumers receive curated exports only.

constraints: no untrusted target code execution by default

comparison_dimensions.name: runtime
comparison_dimensions.preference: Python-first CLI with optional TypeScript services
comparison_dimensions.notes: Direct adoption is stronger when Python integration is available; TypeScript can still be useful for service or pattern borrowing.

comparison_dimensions.name: agent_orchestration
comparison_dimensions.preference: Composable orchestration primitives, durable state, and explicit tool boundaries

comparison_dimensions.name: safety_model
comparison_dimensions.preference: No-exec/static analysis path and clear sandbox gates before running repo-defined commands

comparison_dimensions.name: evidence_artifacts
comparison_dimensions.preference: Traceable Claim/Evidence/Finding/Verdict records that downstream adapters can consume

claim_targets.query: Compare repo capabilities and constraints against the Scout agent orchestration stack profile.
